acid_sprayer+spore_sacs.name: Miasma Sacs
acid_sprayer+spore_sacs.desc: The cloud eats metal first and lungs second.

adrenal_tubes+quill_ridge.name: Wrathquills
adrenal_tubes+quill_ridge.desc: Each quill is wired straight into the temper.

amber_hive_crown+leech_maw.name: Honeymaw
amber_hive_crown+leech_maw.desc: The hive has a mouth now, and the mouth is never full.

arc_cannon+spark_prod.name: Galvanic Lance
arc_cannon+spark_prod.desc: One limb, two terminals, and nowhere safe to stand.

bone_plating+crystal_lattice.name: Mirrorbone
bone_plating+crystal_lattice.desc: Polished plates that hand every blow back to its owner.

brimstone_tail+scorpion_tail.name: Sulphur Sting
brimstone_tail+scorpion_tail.desc: The armour goes first, and the venom follows it in.

butcher_blade+squid_arm.name: Riptide Cleaver
butcher_blade+squid_arm.desc: It holds you still for the part that matters.

capacitor_heel+widow_leg.name: Jolt Widow
capacitor_heel+widow_leg.desc: The sting numbs, and then the numbness burns.

cinder_fist+mold_tendril.name: Blightbrand
cinder_fist+mold_tendril.desc: Rot that smoulders, and embers that spread like mould.

compound_eyes+stalker_eyes.name: Thousand Stare
compound_eyes+stalker_eyes.desc: Every facet has already chosen who falls next.

dynamo_core+ember_core.name: Plasma Heart
dynamo_core+ember_core.desc: Coal and current, wound together until they glow white.

fin_fan+seedpod_rattle.name: Rainmaker
fin_fan+seedpod_rattle.desc: One shake and the whole pack stands a little taller.

flail_tail+grudge_flame.name: Mourning Star
flail_tail+grudge_flame.desc: It burns brighter for every friend it has lost.

flicker_blade+mantis_arm.name: Thresher
flicker_blade+mantis_arm.desc: You hear the second cut before you feel the first.

frost_crest+snapping_beak.name: Winterkill
frost_crest+snapping_beak.desc: It waits for the cold to do most of the work.

jelly_crown+static_antennae.name: Thunderbloom
jelly_crown+static_antennae.desc: A drifting crown of tendrils that hums before it strikes.

leech_maw+venom_fangs.name: Bloodrot Maw
leech_maw+venom_fangs.desc: It sours the blood first, then drinks every drop.

lightning_rod_tail+prism_fan.name: Stormglass
lightning_rod_tail+prism_fan.desc: Lightning goes in one side and comes out aimed.

mantis_arm+quartz_knuckle.name: Facet Scythe
mantis_arm+quartz_knuckle.desc: Every cut hones the edge a little keener.

marsh_hopper+rootfoot.name: Mangrove Stride
marsh_hopper+rootfoot.desc: Wherever it stands, it is already drinking.

mycelium_coat+overgrown_heart.name: Graveheart
mycelium_coat+overgrown_heart.desc: It stops once, then starts again much faster.

nectar_sacs+spore_sacs.name: Bittersweet
nectar_sacs+spore_sacs.desc: Sweet for the pack, bitter for everyone else.

overgrown_heart+rib_spurs.name: Thornheart
overgrown_heart+rib_spurs.desc: A caged heart that beats harder the more you hurt it.

raptor_leg+stalker_paw.name: Nightpounce
raptor_leg+stalker_paw.desc: It lands before the shadow does.

rime_hoof+stampede_hoof.name: Avalanche Hoof
rime_hoof+stampede_hoof.desc: It starts slow, and then the whole slope is moving.

snowmoth_wings+void_moth_wings.name: Eclipse Moth
snowmoth_wings+void_moth_wings.desc: Frost falls from wings that are not really there.
